tables.sql: SELECT id, seller_id, model_id, title, description, price, brand, model, year, displacement_cc, mileage, engine_type, country_code, city, verification_level, is_verified, has_circulacion, has_sticker, has_seguro, seller_type, status, color, created_at, updated_at FROM listings WHERE status != 'archived'

SELECT l.id AS listing_id, m.id AS model_id, CASE WHEN lmm.is_correct_match IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label FROM listings l CROSS JOIN models m LEFT JOIN listing_model_matches lmm ON l.id = lmm.listing_id AND m.id = lmm.model_id WHERE MOD(HASHTEXT(l.id::text), 10) < 8

SELECT l.id AS listing_id, m.id AS model_id, CASE WHEN lmm.is_correct_match IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label FROM listings l CROSS JOIN models m LEFT JOIN listing_model_matches lmm ON l.id = lmm.listing_id AND m.id = lmm.model_id WHERE MOD(HASHTEXT(l.id::text), 10) >= 8
